# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Generated visual helpers reduced average accuracy in a reasoning study](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-27/01-generated-visual-helpers.html) — The preprint compares an added image with a baseline retaining the original and reports exceptions.
- [NASA tests three crop candidates for future space menus](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-26/01-space-crop-candidates.html) — Strawberries, cucumbers and lemon basil face distinct selection stages before potential flight experiments.
- [NASA updates supplier programme and reports Boeing–GRACE agreement](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-26/02-supplier-development.html) — Boeing funds the nearly $500,000 agreement; the article and signing ceremony have different dates.
- [NASA explains how amateur astronomers help track kilonovae](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-25/01-kilonova-catcher-network.html) — Kilonova Catcher connects transient alerts with telescope observations around the world.
- [NASA releases documentary on the making of Europa Clipper](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-24/01-europa-concept-documentary.html) — The Europa Concept follows preparations for a mission whose Jupiter science still lies ahead.
- [NASA outlines AMPERE Hall thruster competition terms](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-19/01-ampere-prototype-challenge.html) — Up to two teams may advance from design to testing with awards of up to $250,000 each.
- [NASA targets CRS-25 station cargo launch no earlier than November 29](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-19/02-crs25-launch-plan.html) — The advisory separates prospective liftoff, spacecraft capture and coverage start times.
- [Chandra translates four star-forming targets into sound](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-18/01-chandra-star-sonifications.html) — A new sonification collection maps brightness and observational bands to audible features.
- [Datasette adds geospatial previews and links between applications](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-16/01-datasette-maps-links.html) — Two new releases offer ways to connect data overviews with detailed views.
- [Datasette updates model connections and a longstanding chart plugin](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-15/01-datasette-compatibility.html) — Two November 14 releases improve compatibility at different stages of working with data.
- [Roman instruments align ahead of the next starlight-control stage](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-14/01-roman-instrument-alignment.html) — NASA confirms a commissioning milestone, distinct from completion of all scientific preparations.
- [XYBench asks whether an answer solves the underlying problem](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-14/02-xybench-underlying-goals.html) — Ai2 distinguishes literal requests from goals, with current coverage limited to English procedural questions.
- [SimReady validates asset properties while grasping tests the whole scene](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-14/03-simready-task-validation.html) — NVIDIA describes a constrained pick-and-place example without establishing reliability on physical hardware.
- [ChatGPT Wallet links agent purchases to user approval](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-14/04-wallet-purchase-approval.html) — Initial rollout is limited to eligible US Pro users, with fuller delegation described as a future plan.
- [Today’s APOD combines two lunar frames into a stereo scene](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-14/05-apollo-surveyor-stereo.html) — The November 14 publication revisits the 1969 Surveyor 3 visit rather than reporting a new mission.
- [Google Search gains Gemini 4 Hydrogen](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-13/01-hydrogen-search.html) — The announcement targets complex questions, while individual answers still need verification.
- [ISS crew prepares Dragon to return research samples](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-13/02-dragon-return-preparations.html) — NASA describes cargo packing and suit maintenance, with spacecraft departure still ahead.
- [Navajo Reservoir rises sharply after autumn rains](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-13/03-navajo-reservoir-rise.html) — Satellite views show water gains, while short-term drought relief does not erase every long-term deficit.
- [llama.cpp 1.0.0 makes library compatibility boundaries clearer](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-13/04-llama-library-versioning.html) — The team establishes explicit version rules for public interfaces, while application upgrades still need validation.
- [LLMON marks instructions and data as different context components](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-11-13/05-llmon-structured-context.html) — IBM introduced experimental Granite previews, with learned separation distinct from enforced security guarantees.
